local rewrite
description: Finished local rewrite of Anismash/aikaterna Retrosign for Red 3.5. Makes an 80s retro-wave sign from one word or three lines separated by ';'. Five bundled background artworks and four chrome styles. Server admins pin art with [p]retrosignset. Renders on the bot with Pillow — no Photofunia, no API, no outbound requests.
install_msg: Retrosign installed. Load with `[p]load retrosign`. `[p]retrosign Electric; Night; Ride`. Admins: `[p]retrosignset preview` then `[p]retrosignset background 2` / `[p]retrosignset style 1`. This is a local rewrite of the Photofunia cog aikaterna removed in 2021.
short: Local 80s retro-wave signs with bundled artwork
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users. Guild settings store only the chosen background id and style id.
